verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS AI product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and mentions of the Codex SDK or switching models (e.g. gpt-5.6-sol) say nothing about API versioning or deprecation timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
